scripts.bootstrap: npm ci && npm ci --prefix apps/obsidian && npm run build:core --prefix apps/obsidian
scripts.check: npm run check:server && npm run check:clients && node scripts/share-texts.mjs --check && npm run check:backup && npm run check:release && node --check tests/interop/gateway-baseline.mjs && node --check tests/interop/baseline.mjs && node apps/obsidian/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tests/interop/tsconfig.json && npm run check --prefix apps/obsidian
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build --prefix apps/obsidian
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --prefix apps/obsidian && npm run test:clients
scripts.build:server: npm run build:notes && npm run build:cli && npm run build --workspace @tabularium/server
scripts.build:cli: npm run build:core --prefix apps/obsidian && apps/obsidian/node_modules/.bin/vite build --config apps/server/clients/cli/vite.config.ts apps/server/clients/cli && node apps/server/build-cli.mjs
scripts.build:notes: npm run build:core --prefix apps/obsidian && apps/obsidian/node_modules/.bin/vite build --config apps/server/clients/notes/vite.config.ts apps/server/clients/notes
scripts.test:settings:obsidian: npm run build --prefix apps/obsidian && npm run test:tabularium:settings --prefix apps/obsidian
scripts.test:sorting:obsidian: npm run build --prefix apps/obsidian && npm run test:tabularium:sorting --prefix apps/obsidian
scripts.test:release: npm run build:notes && npm run build:cli && node tests/release/clean-install.mjs
scripts.test:backup: npm run build:notes && npm run build:cli && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/backup/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:backup:clients: npm run build:notes && npm run build:cli && node tests/backup/clients.mjs
scripts.test:server:browser: npm run build:notes && npm run test:browser --workspace @tabularium/server
scripts.test:clients: npm run build:core --prefix apps/obsidian && cd apps/obsidian && node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config ../server/clients/vitest.config.ts && node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config ../server/clients/notes/vite.config.ts --dir ../server/clients/notes
scripts.check:clients: npm run build:core --prefix apps/obsidian && cd apps/obsidian && for app in notes cli browser webapp; do node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p ../server/clients/$app/tsconfig.json || exit 1; done && node_modules/.bin/tsx _tools/checkOwnNames.ts ../server/clients
